# Edwards Radio

> Edwards Radio is the indie folk project of songwriter Evan Parker. Lyric-driven, analog-leaning songs that sit between folk, indie rock, and alt-country.

## About

Edwards Radio is the musical project of songwriter Evan Parker. Parker writes, records, and produces all material in his home studio, blending the raw sincerity of folk with the textured depth of indie rock. The work is intentionally lo-fi and analog-leaning, capturing performances with a DIY spirit while preserving emotional weight.

## Discography

- **Feral Nights** (2022) — Debut album. Lo-fi indie and Americana, raw and intimate.
- **This Endless Life** (2023) — Folk-leaning songs with analog warmth and reflective lyricism.
- **The Weight of Illusion** (2025) — Lyric-driven, analog-leaning indie folk. Spacious, intimate, and handmade.
- **Underwater** (Coming 2026) — Upcoming fourth album. Lyric-driven indie folk with analog warmth.

## Genre

Folk · Indie · Alt-Country · Indie Folk · Lo-Fi
